notes: Prospective, non-randomised comparative study, 2024-2025, Department of Ophthalmology, University Hospital Centre 'Sestre milosrdnice', Zagreb, Croatia; Caucasian children aged 8-17 years.

Groups by the spectacle lenses the children were wearing at enrolment ('regular users'); lens choice by patient and parent preference; baseline is the enrolment visit (treatment may have started before it).
All 57 enrolled children (SVL 20, HAPD 21, HAL 16) were followed for 12 months (Study limitations) and appear in Table 2; parent-reported wear of at least 12 h/day was an eligibility requirement.
Right eyes only (Methods); axial length by IOLMaster 700 under cycloplegia; visits at baseline, 6 and 12 months.
Table 2 also tabulates spherical equivalent, sphere and cylinder (not extracted).
